description: Part of the Overpowered skill suite. Pressure-test a rule, decision table, SOP, requirement, or business process by finding edge cases and alternative branches that would break a happy-path specification. Use before automation or formalization when hidden exceptions could change behavior; focus on material exceptions, not imaginative trivia.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
